record.one_liner: AI-powered customer support helpdesk (ticketing, inbox, AI Agent) for ecommerce brands
record.auth_notes: REST API: HTTP Basic with the account email as username and a REST API key (created in helpdesk settings) as password, so it is classed as api_key. Official MCP endpoint uses OAuth.
record.access_notes: Pricing page offers a free trial with no credit card. REST API is listed on all Helpdesk plans; no free permanent tier was seen. API use after the trial needs a paid plan. Account owner and admins create API keys.
record.api_notes: Documented REST API at a per-account base URL (https://{your-domain}.gorgias.com/api/). Rate limit 2 req/s on the plans shown. Breadth not fully reviewed; only the auth and overview pages were read.
record.blocker_notes: Trial path exists for REST API keys. Official MCP is in open beta for paid plan customers, so production use after the trial needs a paid plan.

evidence.quote: Under API Access & Credentials, you'll find the Base API URL, your Username, and Password (API Key).
Authorize the connection via OAuth. You will be prompted to log into your Gorgias account.
The Gorgias REST API lets you read and write data in your helpdesk programmatically.
Add a new MCP server using this endpoint: mcp.gorgias.com/mcp?gorgias_subdomain=YOUR-SUBDOMAIN.
Currently in open beta, open to all paid plan customers.
